name: Pooled Vitality banks a charge when an ability is paid with health (#2229)
contract: Pooled Vitality 681078: 'abilities paid with health grant Pooled Vitality, stacking $680687u times'. The talent's own effect is an aura 4 (SPELL_AURA_DUMMY) marker; the behaviour is already native to this fork. Spell::TakePower (Spell.cpp:5416-5422) flags a non-triggered SpellFamilyName 26 cast paid with POWER_HEALTH when the caster holds 681078, and AscensionBloodmageVitality.cpp:78-79 then casts Pooled Vitality 680687, whose Spell.dbc StackAmount is 10. Rotclaw 503486, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h, has PowerType -2 (POWER_HEALTH) with ManaCostPercentage 10, so it is a health-paid family 26 ability. This is a regression guard over the existing handler, not a new fix; the stack arithmetic and the consumption guard are covered by the CoA unit test in apps/coa-tests/pooled_vitality/.
